summary: Issue #525 P2.10-A1 KPI envelope schema: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. Migration 020 adds analytics_kpi_envelopes with UNIQUE(shop_id,kind), JSONB payload, timestamptz, RLS matching 017. AnalyticsKpiEnvelopesRepo upsert/get_by_kind; 6/6 unit+contract tests pass. No Redis/webhook/API/Demo. No CRITICAL reliability/security/observability/performance gaps.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note: ORM payload uses JSON; Alembic uses JSONB for SQLite unit-test compatibility.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: dialect-aware JSONB on Postgres-only paths when a second consumer needs it.

criticalFindings.description: AC idempotent round-trip is covered for payload/computed_at; envelope_version is written but not re-asserted on get_by_kind after a version bump.
